ICD-10 codes in HCUP CCSR categories

Source: R/ccsr.R
nis_ccsr_codes.Rd

Returns the full ICD-10-CM or ICD-10-PCS codes assigned to the requested categories in a bundled AHRQ HCUP CCSR release. Use nis_add_ccsr() for exact, year-aware matching on a lazy NIS query.

Usage

nis_ccsr_codes(
  categories,
  file = NULL,
  default_only = FALSE,
  type = c("dx", "pr"),
  version = NULL
)

Arguments

categories

Character vector of CCSR category codes, such as "CIR019". Matching ignores case.

file

Optional path to an HCUP reference file for a custom or newer release. The file determines whether the mapping is for diagnoses or procedures.

default_only

If TRUE, keep only codes whose default inpatient category is in categories. Diagnosis reference files only.

type

"dx" for diagnosis or "pr" for procedure lookups in the bundled data.

version

A bundled version, such as "2025.1". The default is the latest bundled release of the requested type.

Value

A sorted character vector of unique codes without periods.

Details

The reference file may be the HCUP Excel workbook (.xlsx, which needs the readxl package) or the HCUP comma-separated file. Excel files are read from the DX_to_CCSR_Mapping or PR_to_CCSR_Mapping sheet. Comma-separated files use the wide layout with CCSR CATEGORY 1, CCSR CATEGORY 2, and so on. A code mapped to a category in any of those columns is returned.

With default_only = TRUE, only codes whose default inpatient CCSR category is one of categories are returned. This matches the HCUP assignment of a single category to a principal diagnosis, so combine it with an exact match on the principal diagnosis code. Procedure reference files have no default assignment.

See also

Defining cohorts.

Other cohort-definition: nis_attrition(), nis_audit_code_transition(), nis_audit_dx_position(), nis_audit_prday(), nis_flag_dx(), nis_flag_pr(), nis_flag_pr_timing()

Examples

head(nis_ccsr_codes("CIR019"))
